paragraphs: Rabbi Dostai, son of Rabbi Yehudah: Sifrei Haazinu; Kiddushin 64a, 67a, 74b, 77a. In Bava Kamma 83, end of side b: ben Yehudah; Derekh Eretz, chapter 2. In Arakhin 30, end of side a, he disagrees with Rabbi; and Rabbi Yose ben Kipper, Tosefta Sheviit chapter 2. In Rabbi Shimon’s name: Chullin 123b. In chapter Arba Mitot and chapter Ein Dorshin, Rabbi said in the name of Abba Yose ben Dostai; perhaps he is his son. Rabbi Yehudah ben Dostai may be his father or his son.
